deviations: Added a public `face_stratum` lift helper (vendor/truck/truck-evidence/src/contact.rs) that is not in the packet's section-2 API list: `BoundedStratum::Face` carries a `CanonicalSurface`, which has no `Unrecognized` arm, so the stage-3 refusal for a `CanonicalCarrierWitness::Unrecognized` carrier can only live at the stratum-lift boundary, and required test 4 (spline) needs that boundary to exist. The dispatcher itself is exactly the packet's stage order.

Required test 2 constructs the coincident pair from two equal dyadic carriers (`Plane::xy()` and an equivalent `Plane::new` triple) rather than from distinct triples on the same plane, because distinct triples cannot be `PartialEq`-equal carriers (see disagreements).
disagreements: Packet stage 3 and required test 4 say `contact()` must refuse a `CanonicalCarrierWitness::Unrecognized` carrier. The anchored `BoundedStratum` signature holds a `CanonicalSurface`, which has no `Unrecognized` arm, so an Unrecognized carrier can never reach `contact()`. The refusal is enforced at the `face_stratum` lift boundary with the same `EnvelopeCase::ContactReductionDeferred`, and test 4 asserts it there.

Packet required test 2 says 'Plane::new twice from different dyadic triples lying on the same plane' must fire stage 1 with `locus = Coincident` / `kind = IdenticalCarrier`. `Plane` stores its three defining points verbatim (`Plane::new` is a plain field-assigning const fn; there is no canonical normalization in `truck-geometry`), so different triples on the same geometric plane are not `PartialEq`-equal `CanonicalSurface` values and the `lhs.surface == rhs.surface` identity test cannot fire on them; such a pair lands in the analytic stage instead (`plane_plane` -> `Coincident` -> `Region2`/`CoincidentInterval`). The C0-C2 identity stage fires only on struct-equal carriers, so the test uses two construction paths producing the same dyadic carrier.
notes: Signature amendments recorded per packet section 2 and the finish block: (1) `contact(lhs: &BoundedStratum, rhs: &BoundedStratum, budget: &mut Budget)` takes references rather than the plan's by-value `BoundedStratum` (the strata carry `CanonicalSurface`, which contains `Processor<Box<..>>` and is not `Copy`; the dispatcher inspects both before constructing anything, and the Boundary Rewrite iterates every pair); `ContactComplex` is returned by value as booked. (2) One new `truck_base::evidence::EnvelopeCase` arm, `ContactReductionDeferred`, with the packet's doc comment. Stage-3 refusal coverage (all return `Err(Refusal::UnsupportedEnvelope(EnvelopeCase::ContactReductionDeferred))`): any pair with a `Face` and an `Edge`/`Vertex`; any `Edge`/`Edge` (unequal), `Edge`/`Vertex`, `Vertex`/anything pair; any FF pair whose carrier is `Torus` or `Placed`; any canonical analytic FF pair outside the section 3.3 table (e.g. Cylinder x Cylinder, Sphere x Cone); and `Unrecognized` carriers at the `face_stratum` lift boundary (see disagreements). The two built stages spend nothing from `budget` (the analytic pairs take none, no subdivision happens) and pass the untouched ledger into each certificate's `budget_left`; every certificate is an explicit field-by-field `Certificate { props, method: Method::Exact, budget_left, margin: Margin::UNBOUNDED, modulus: Modulus::Unbounded }` with `Prop::AnalyticCarrier = True`. Representation infeasibility read: an Unrecognized/non-canonical carrier has no in-scope representation inside `BoundedStratum::Face` (the carrier field is `CanonicalSurface`, which is exactly the canonical set), so that refusal necessarily happens before `contact()`; and geometrically-coincident-but-structurally-distinct carriers cannot be detected by the C0-C2 stage because coincidence is keyed on `PartialEq` of the raw carrier fields. No `unscaled_legacy()` calls were added (ceiling 111 unchanged).
